plugins.name: Ambient Soundscapes
plugins.description: Looping background sound (rain, wind, a fire, a tavern) that can follow the place a chapter is set in. The sounds are made on your PC; nothing is downloaded.
plugins.author: MrSquirrely

plugins.name: Gamification
plugins.description: Experience for every word you write, levels from Scribbler to Legend, and 30 achievements for word counts, streaks, sprints and worldbuilding.
plugins.author: MrSquirrely

plugins.name: Genre Rule Packs
plugins.description: Rules and whole-manuscript checks for romance, mystery, fantasy, science fiction and thrillers. The packs follow your project's genre.
plugins.author: MrSquirrely

plugins.name: Map Maker
plugins.description: A map of your world, imported or drawn, with a pin for each place. Shows distances and travel times, and rule MAP001 flags journeys in the text that do not fit the map.
plugins.author: MrSquirrely
